sample_unit: CT scans (internal n=268, external n=103, independent n=70)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy across internal, external, and independent multi-center cohorts
links.effect: Accuracy ranged from 75.7% to 82.5% across internal (n=268), external (n=103) and independent (n=70) cohorts, described as robust generalizability.
links.quote: Validated across multi-center internal (n = 268), external (n = 103), and independent (n = 70) cohorts, AI-PACS demonstrated robust generalizability with diagnostic accuracies of 75.7%–82.5%.

unlisted_practices: Self-supervised anomaly detection trained on unlabelled normal scans to address scarcity of labelled cases
3D anatomical localization output for interventional guidance

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI platform integrated with PACS for detecting radiolucent foreign body aspiration in a reader benchmark study comparing performance and reading time against expert radiologists.
